source_title: Measuring Land Subsidence with PS-InSAR in Bangkok using Sentinel-1 Time-Series Techniques
author: Sawitree Luachapichatikul
source_rights: Repository states all rights reserved unless otherwise indicated. PDF is retained for local fact-check only; do not redistribute.
extracted_facts: Table 4 and pages 34-39 report four benchmark/descending-PS pairs, relative rates, leveling R-squared, InSAR time-series standard deviation, and nearest point distances. The leveling rate is vertical; the PS rate is descending-orbit LOS-relative. Thesis describes leveling observations in 2011, 2012, 2016 and 2018 and PS series January 2016 to October 2019, with rates referenced to BKK5127.
interpretation: Published precedent only; not a matched re-analysis or validation of the current LiCSAR/WabInSAR products.
